title: Local well-posedness for the KdV equation on the half-line at the critical regularity $H^{-\frac34}$
summary: We prove local well-posedness for the initial-boundary-value problem for the Korteweg--de Vries equation on the right half-line at the critical regularity $s=-3/4$, with initial and boundary data in $H^{-3/4}(\mathbb R_+)$ and $H^{1/12}(\mathbb R_+)$, respectively. This reaches the endpoint left open in the previous half-line results of Holmer (2006) and Bona, Sun, and Zhang (2006), who established local well-posedness for $s>-3/4$.
